name: Hoback Pipeline
researcher_notes: Not an existing row. No roster row lists Merna or Jackson for this line, and the Crow Creek line (P4455) runs from Montpelier, Idaho to Afton, Wyoming. A Lower Valley Energy presentation from October 2012 describes 49.7 miles of 6 inch gas pipe from the Williams Merna tap through Bondurant and Hoback Canyon to Jackson, Wyoming. The EIA pipeline projects table for August 2026, sheet Historical Projects, Excel row 568, lists Hoback Pipeline Energy Project, operator Lower Valley Energy Coop, completed, in service 2008 (completed December 12, 2008), Wyoming only, 49.75 miles, 6 inches, intrastate, state authority. The two sources agree on length and diameter. They are not fully independent because the presentation is the operator's own. Length is well above the 25 km threshold and the line is built, so the step requirement is met. EIA also lists a cost of 20 million dollars and a capacity of 5.81 million cubic feet per day. These were left out because only one source gives them and the cost looks low. Owner spelling matches the existing gazetteer entry Lower Valley Energy. No route researched yet. Intrastate line, so FERC silence is expected; a Wyoming Public Service Commission filing could be added as a second ref.
